title: Visual tokens and image token budgets
description: Patchifying an image into tokens, how patch size and resolution set the number of visual tokens, and what that costs the LLM.

title: Vision-language models
description: A vision encoder joined to an LLM by a connector (MLP projector or Q-Former), the two-stage LLaVA recipe, and how VLMs are evaluated.

title: Any-resolution vision and patch-n-pack
description: AnyRes tiling, native dynamic resolution with 2D/3D rotary positions, and packing variable-length images with a block-diagonal mask.

title: Video tokens and long-video cost
description: Frames per second, pooling, temporal positions, and the token and KV-cache arithmetic of long video.

title: Mixture of experts
description: Replacing the feed-forward block by many experts and a top-k router; total versus active parameters, shared and fine-grained experts.

title: Load balancing, capacity and expert parallelism
description: The auxiliary load-balancing loss (derived), capacity factor and token dropping, bias-based balancing, and all-to-all expert parallelism.

title: Sliding-window, sparse and differential attention
description: Attention masks that cut cost to O(N W), global-plus-local layouts, and differential attention as noise cancellation.

title: KV memory: MQA, GQA and multi-head latent attention
description: Counting KV-cache bytes per attention variant and shrinking it by sharing or compressing keys and values.

title: State-space models and selective recurrences
description: Linear recurrences with constant-size state, discretisation, and Mamba-style input-dependent parameters.

title: Parallel scan and hybrid SSM-transformers
description: Computing a linear recurrence in O(log N) depth with an associative operator, and mixing attention and SSM layers (Jamba).

title: Data, tensor and pipeline parallelism
description: How a model and batch are split over GPUs, what is communicated, and the pipeline bubble.

title: ZeRO and FSDP memory model
description: Per-GPU bytes for weights, gradients and optimizer state in mixed-precision Adam, and how ZeRO stages 1-3 shard them.

title: Mixed precision and loss scaling
description: FP16, BF16 and FP32 roles, FP32 master weights, gradient underflow and static or dynamic loss scaling.

title: Gradient checkpointing
description: Trading recomputation for activation memory, the sqrt(L) schedule and its FLOP overhead.

title: Multi-token prediction
description: Supervising each position on several future tokens, sequential MTP modules and the joint loss.
